name: Cobra's Ammo Stack
teaser: Configure ammunition stack sizes by caliber with support for vanilla and modded ammo.
description_html:
Cobra’s Ammo Stack

Take complete control over ammunition stack sizes in SPT 4.1.x.

Cobra’s Ammo Stack is a lightweight, server-side mod that lets you configure ammunition stack sizes by caliber, supports custom ammunition from other mods, and allows individual item overrides using a simple JSON configuration file.

Features

  • Configure stack sizes by caliber
  • Supports vanilla ammunition
  • Supports modded ammunition
  • Automatic support for custom calibers
  • Individual item stack size overrides
  • Configurable default stack size
  • Configurable grenade launcher ammunition stack sizes
  • Lightweight server-side implementation
  • No client installation required
  • Minimal startup logging

Installation

  1. Download the latest release.
  2. Extract the ZIP file.
  3. Drag the included SPT folder into your SPT installation.
  4. Allow Windows to merge the folders.
  5. Start the SPT Server.

Note: Some SPT 4.1.x installations use an SPT_Runtime folder. If your installation includes it, install the mod to SPT_Runtime/user/mods. Otherwise, install it to user/mods.

Configuration

Edit the included config.json to customize ammunition stack sizes.

Available configuration options include:

  • Default ammunition stack size
  • Per-caliber stack sizes
  • Custom caliber support
  • Individual item overrides
  • Optional startup logging

Compatibility

  • SPT 4.1.x
  • No additional dependencies
  • Compatible with Fika
